blocks.text: Har aabi (aqueous) solution mein H⁺ aur OH⁻ ki concentrations itni kam hoti hain ke unhen likhna aur hisab mein istemal karna mushkil hai. 1909 mein Danish biochemist Sorenson ne pH aur pOH ki istilah (term) di, aur pH aur pOH ke scales bane. Yeh dono aise nikalte hain:

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat!
blocks.text: Aise solutions bhi maujood hain jin ka pH manfi (negative) ya 14 se zyada hota hai.
25°C par pH ki qeemat aam taur par 0 se 14 ke darmiyan hoti hai.
Kuch jani pehchani aabi solutions ki pH qeematein Figure 9.1 mein hain. Is se aam istemal ke solutions ki tezabi (acidic) ya basic nau'iyat samajhne mein madad milti hai.

blocks.alt: Dohri nok wala teer: surkh (tezabi), safed (neutral), neela (basic); neeche pH 0-14, oopar [H3O+] 10^0 se 10^-14, Neutral 10^-7 par. Andar: HCl (1.0 M) pH 0.0, stomach acid pH 1.0-3.0, lemon juice pH 2.2-2.4, vinegar pH 2.4-3.4, carbonated water pH 3.9, beer pH 4.0-4.5, milk pH 6.4, blood pH 7.4, seawater pH 7.0-8.3, baking soda (0.1 M) pH 8.4, milk of magnesia pH 10.5, household ammonia pH 11.9, NaOH (1.0 M) pH 14.0.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.1: Kuch aam cheezon ki pH values (kitab ki Figure 9.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Sample Problem 9.1
blocks.problem: Ek solution ka pH 9.2 hai. 25°C par pani ka ionic product Kw nikalein.
steps: pH ka antilog [H⁺] deta hai: [H⁺] = 10⁻ᵖᴴ = 10⁻⁹·² ≈ 6.3 × 10⁻¹⁰ M
pOH ka antilog [OH⁻] deta hai: [OH⁻] = 10⁻ᵖᴼᴴ = 10⁻⁴·⁸ ≈ 1.6 × 10⁻⁵ M
Kw = [H⁺][OH⁻] = (6.3 × 10⁻¹⁰) × (1.6 × 10⁻⁵) = 1.008 × 10⁻¹⁴ (yeh aakhri qadam kitab mein nahi chhapa)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne pehle antilog mein “[OH⁻] = 10⁻ᵖᴴ” aur “[OH⁻] ≈ 6.3 × 10⁻¹⁰ M” likha hai. pH se H⁺ ki concentration milti hai, is liye sahi [H⁺] = 10⁻⁹·² ≈ 6.3 × 10⁻¹⁰ M hai; [OH⁻] pOH se milta hai (1.6 × 10⁻⁵ M).

blocks.title: Sample Problem 9.2
blocks.problem: 25°C par Kw = 1.0 × 10⁻¹⁴ hai aur solution mein H⁺ ki concentration 1.0 × 10⁻⁷ M hai. OH⁻ ki concentration, pH aur pOH nikalein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne [OH⁻] = 1.0 × 10⁻¹⁴ / 1.0 × 10⁻⁷ ka jawab 1.0 × 10⁻¹⁴ chhapa hai. Taqseem (division) ka sahi jawab 1.0 × 10⁻⁷ M hai; isi se pOH = 7 aata hai.

blocks.prompt: a) pH 4.0 aur pH 10.0 wale do solutions barabar hajm (volume) mein milaye gaye. 25°C par is mixture ka Kw kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Kw sirf temperature par munhasir (depend) hai, solution par nahi. 25°C par Kw = 1.0 × 10⁻¹⁴ hi rahega. (Dono solutions mein 10⁻⁴ M H⁺ aur 10⁻⁴ M OH⁻ hain, jo barabar hajm mein mil kar ek doosre ko neutralize kar dete hain; mixture ka pH taqreeban 7 hota hai.)

blocks.prompt: b) Kw = 1.0 × 10⁻¹⁴ aur [OH⁻] = 2.5 × 10⁻⁸ M. [H⁺] aur pH nikalein.
c) Copper-plate etching ka solution 0.30 M HNO₃ hai. 25°C par [H⁺], pH, [OH⁻] aur pOH nikalein.
blocks.explanation: HNO₃ strong acid hai aur poora ionize hota hai, to [H⁺] = 0.30 mol dm⁻³ aur pH = −log 0.30 = 0.52. [OH⁻] = Kw / [H⁺] = 1.0 × 10⁻¹⁴ / 0.30 = 3.3 × 10⁻¹⁴ mol dm⁻³, aur pOH = 14 − 0.52 = 13.48.

items: Sorenson (1909): pH = −log[H⁺], pOH = −log[OH⁻]; neutral pani mein pH = pOH = 7; 25°C par pH + pOH = 14.
pH aam taur par 0 se 14 hota hai, magar manfi aur 14 se zyada pH bhi mumkin hai.
